articles.title: Masdar Raises US$600 Million in Global Record AA-Rated Blue Bond for Offshore Wind Projects
articles.summary: Masdar raised US$600 million through its first blue bond, the highest-rated public blue bond globally, under its US$6 billion program. Proceeds will fund maritime renewable energy projects, supporting sustainable ocean use and clean energy infrastructure.
